design_principle: Agent authors strategy-specific logic; the Skill constrains lifecycle, public APIs, timing, portability, and validation.

lifecycle_components.purpose: one-time parameters, benchmark, costs, universe and schedule registration
PIT universe construction and factor preparation before the session
daily or per-minute bar event handling
named scheduled callbacks; minute profile fires before handle_data on the matching end-labelled bar

canonical_code_policy.security_code_style: .SS/.SZ/.BJ PTrade public style; local adapter normalizes aliases
canonical_code_policy.dual_target_source: one canonical Python source is copied to both targets after validation
canonical_code_policy.batch_api_policy: use portable per-security APIs in canonical code; local-only batch APIs are forbidden
canonical_code_policy.storage_policy: Strategy code never accesses DuckDB, providers, or local files directly; local backtests route injected APIs through provider adapters.
canonical_code_policy.api_subset: PTrade backtest public API subset is authoritative; local adapter must emulate it.
canonical_code_policy.indicator_policy: Use numpy/pandas or source-defined helpers; do not assume locally injected MyTT names exist on PTrade.
canonical_code_policy.runtime_state_policy: Every lifecycle and scheduled callback calls an idempotent _ensure_runtime_state() as its first executable statement.
canonical_code_policy.local_backtest_data_priority: <current-project>/data/quantstudio.db first; configured/external DuckDB only when absent or explicitly customer-approved.
canonical_code_policy.event_data_policy: External event files are ingested into strategy_events by a generic importer; local-only strategies query them through get_strategy_events and never read files directly.
canonical_code_policy.target_routing_policy: R0 explicitly selects dual-target or QuantStudio-only. Dual ETF strategies use a user-confirmed static whitelist; QuantStudio-only ETF strategies may use get_etf_list_local and get_history_batch.

engine_profiles.execution: current synthetic completed-bar price through public order APIs
engine_profiles.purpose: causal daily-data proxy when confirmed semantics require open entry and close exit but historical minute coverage is unavailable
